reason: Both correctly identified a normal, no-repair situation and advised filling rinse aid despite all-in-one tablets and moving off Eco 50, but Conversation 2 covered all the acceptable directions: it also addressed unloading immediately (leave the door closed until the end, then crack it open) and loading (avoid nested or face-up cups), and it explicitly used the 'hot and steamy' finding to rule out a heater fault, giving a more complete and honest diagnosis. Conversation 1 never raised unloading timing or loading despite these being important unknowns, and its repeated reference to 'Hot Wash' and 'Hot Rinse' options is not an accurate description of Bosch Serie 4 programme controls. Conversation 2 also added a sensible hot-steam caution and a reasonable test sequence, while neither recommended parts or escalation.
